article_title_en: Modern Pangasius Farming: A Reliable Step-by-Step Guide

images.concept: Round tarpaulin pond with adult pangasius visible at the surface, active aerator producing fine ripples, farmer holding floating pellets, bright midday light
images.prompt: Photorealistic photograph of a round blue tarpaulin pond (kolam terpal bulat) on a semi-intensive freshwater fish farm in Indonesia, containing adult Pangasianodon hypophthalmus (pangasius siam catfish) — long-bodied silver-grey catfish with characteristic flat wide head, long barbels (whiskers), forked tail, and subtly yellowish-white underbelly — visible near the pond surface in slightly turbid green-brown water, an electric paddle-wheel aerator actively churning fine white ripples in the background, an Indonesian farmer in a plain short-sleeve shirt leaning over the pond rim and scattering floating pellet feed from cupped hands, pond edge made of compact soil or low earthen bund, tropical midday bright sunlight casting soft shadows, lush green vegetation or palm trees softly blurred in the background, professional aquaculture trade magazine style, 16:9 wide aspect, no extra fish eyes, no missing barbels, no anatomically incorrect fins, correct number of pectoral fins (one pair), no text overlays, no watermarks, no logos, no dead fish, no algae bloom, no garbage, photorealistic.
images.alt_id: Kolam terpal bundar berisi patin siam dewasa di farm semi-intensif, petani menaburkan pelet, aerator aktif di latar
images.alt_en: Round tarpaulin pond with adult pangasius siam at the surface, farmer scattering pellets, active aerator in background
images.caption_id: Kolam terpal bundar menjadi pilihan entry-level yang populer karena biaya instalasi terjangkau dan kontrol kualitas air jauh lebih baik dibanding kolam tanah. Pada kepadatan 20–40 ekor/m², FCR patin siam bisa mencapai 1,3–1,6 dalam satu siklus.
images.caption_en: Round tarpaulin ponds are the dominant entry-level choice for modern pangasius farming, offering significantly better water-quality control than earthen ponds at a manageable capital cost. At 20–40 fish per square metre, FCR routinely lands in the 1.3–1.6 range over a single cycle.
images.fallback_note: Species accuracy is the main risk: FLUX may render a generic catfish rather than the distinctively broad-headed, long-whiskered P. hypophthalmus. If rendering misses the species, a stock photo from Shutterstock (search: 'pangasius farm Indonesia tarpaulin pond') is a reliable fallback.

images.concept: Comparative silhouette illustration of pangasius from 5 cm fingerling, 10 cm juvenile, 20 cm grower, to 30+ cm harvest size with weight and duration labels
images.prompt: Clean modern educational illustration in a textbook-infographic style showing four Pangasianodon hypophthalmus (pangasius catfish) silhouettes in accurate side-profile view arranged left to right in order of growth — first silhouette at approximately 5 cm length (tiny fry with visible whiskers), second at approximately 10 cm (juvenile, clearly larger), third at approximately 20 cm (sub-adult grower), fourth at approximately 30 cm (harvest-size adult, stockier body) — each silhouette filled in soft blue-grey gradient with anatomically correct elongated catfish body shape, wide flat head, two long barbels, forked caudal fin, all four figures rendered against a clean white background, below each fish silhouette a bracket area for a label block (do not write any specific text, leave blank label brackets [LABEL]), a thin horizontal arrow connecting all four silhouettes from left to right indicating progression, aquaculture education style, soft teal and slate blue palette, no text in the image, no watermarks, no logos, no additional species.
images.alt_id: Ilustrasi empat tahap pertumbuhan patin siam dari benih 5 cm hingga panen 30 cm, ditampilkan berjajar dengan panah kemajuan
images.alt_en: Illustration of four pangasius growth stages from 5 cm fingerling to 30 cm harvest size, arranged in a progression sequence
images.caption_id: Patin siam (*Pangasianodon hypophthalmus*) melewati empat fase nutrisi dari benih 5 cm hingga ukuran panen >30 cm. Kebutuhan protein turun dari 40% di fase benih ke 26% di fase pra-panen seiring perubahan prioritas metabolisme dari pembentukan jaringan ke deposisi otot.
images.caption_en: Pangasius siam progresses through four nutritional phases from a 5 cm fingerling to harvest at over 30 cm. Dietary protein requirements decline from 40% at the starter phase to 26% pre-harvest, reflecting a metabolic shift from tissue formation to muscle and lipid deposition.
images.fallback_note: The prompt avoids text labels to sidestep FLUX's weakness with in-image typography — blank label brackets can be filled in post by the designer using Canva or Photoshop. If silhouettes are anatomically wrong (e.g., wrong tail shape), a commissioned illustration from a local scientific illustrator is the cleanest fallback.

images.concept: Farmer checking water parameters with handheld DO meter and pH meter at the edge of a tarpaulin pond, active aerator in the background
images.prompt: Photorealistic photograph of an Indonesian farmer in a plain work shirt and rubber boots kneeling at the edge of a round blue tarpaulin pond, holding a handheld digital DO meter (dissolved oxygen meter) in one hand and a portable pH meter in the other hand, dipping the probes into the slightly turbid green-brown water, concentrated expression on face, the pond surface shows gentle ripples from an active aerator visible in the mid-background, tropical outdoor setting with natural daylight, green vegetation softly blurred in the far background, professional aquaculture documentation style, 16:9 aspect ratio, realistic equipment (generic modern handheld water quality meter, not branded), no text overlays, no watermarks, no logos, no dead animals, no blood, photorealistic.
images.alt_id: Petani mengukur kadar oksigen terlarut dan pH di tepi kolam terpal patin dengan alat DO meter dan pH meter genggam
images.alt_en: Farmer measuring dissolved oxygen and pH at the edge of a tarpaulin pangasius pond using handheld DO and pH meters
images.caption_id: Lima parameter kualitas air wajib dipantau harian di kolam patin intensif: suhu, pH, DO, ammonia bebas (NH₃), dan CO₂. Aerator AT21 ME500 dari STP ATD menjaga DO di atas 3 ppm — batas minimum agar FCR tidak meleset akibat stres oksigen.
images.caption_en: Five water quality parameters require daily monitoring in intensive pangasius ponds: temperature, pH, DO, free ammonia, and CO₂. Holding DO above 4 ppm is the single highest-leverage variable for keeping FCR on target and average daily gain consistent.
images.fallback_note: Generic 'farmer with water meter at fish pond' is one of FLUX's stronger photorealistic scenes. If human hands or the meter look anatomically wrong, Shutterstock/Adobe Stock has many licensed options for 'aquaculture water quality testing'.
